vetSays.line: 🛡️ Roman, Amara and Jie met them at the door — 3 put down. Roman, Amara, Jie are hurt.
🛡️ Roman, Amara and Beren met them at the door — 3 put down. Roman, Amara, Beren are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Amara, Beren and Tariq met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Amara, Beren are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Devon just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luis just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Amara, Beren, Tariq and Elena met them at the door — 4 put down. Amara, Beren, Tariq are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Amara just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Amara, Beren, Tariq and Elena met them at the door — 4 put down. Amara, Beren, Tariq, Elena are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ray just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ray and James met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. James is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nadia just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ James and Raj met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. James, Raj are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
